cells.value: Coverage, evidence and maintenance
Professional standard: traceable source ownership, dated evidence, reversible packaging and complete file accounting.
Item
Result / rule
Evidence / limitation
Compilation date
9 October 2026, America/Detroit
Source modification dates and historical audit dates are separately retained.
Source boundary
Original packages + October 9 SDK source set + scoped 1Password metadata map.
Includes five additional 1Password source records; other vaults and all secret field contents are excluded from this map.
Source files
Count of on-disk files in the bounded source set; nested ZIP members are separately indexed.
Primary workbook tabs
Original 72 primary tabs + 10 AI Money reference tabs. Historical embedded workbook tabs also retained.
All imported workbook tabs
SOURCE SHEET INDEX enumerates every imported sheet, including historical embedded workbooks.
Unique text bodies
Identical bytes may share a reading location. Every original file still has its own catalog row and archive member.
Original ZIP members
ARCHIVE MEMBERS enumerates all original ZIP and wheel package members, including SDK release artifacts.
Source preservation
Every original file byte is included in Alex_Master_Source_Files.zip.
SHA-256 values in FILE CATALOG and the archive manifest allow verification. No original source was edited.
Spreadsheet preservation
All source values, original formulas, comments and hyperlinks are preserved.
Reading copies show stored formula results; original formulas are in comments and exact original files. Missing saved results are labeled, not invented.
Text preservation
Every UTF-8 source is retained as exact ordered chunks.
Reconstruction checks compare SHA-256 against the original file. Excel-invalid terminal controls use reversible JSON-string encoding, labeled per row.
Binary preservation
Original XLSX and ZIP binaries are preserved in the companion archive.
XLSX additionally has imported reading tabs. Original ZIP contents are member-indexed.
Authority and conflicts
The maintained owning source governs its own subject.
Connector routes → connector source/card; Javar mission/gates → Javar plan; infrastructure → dated inventory; implementation → owning source. Do not merge historical claims into live facts.
Readability
Arial 11 body, restrained bold, 17-point titles, subtle row shading.
Frozen headings, filters and internal links. Dense source evidence is deliberately placed behind the guide.
Known gaps
Existing missing/private/remote/excluded source dispositions are retained.
This cannot prove that no other files exist or that every referenced file is captured. Read BUILD_SOURCE_COVERAGE and GAPS.
Current behavior
1Password metadata listing freshly read; no fresh credential-validity or runtime tests.
Other connector/runtime/billing/remote-installation evidence remains dated. Listed, configured, installed and currently working remain distinct.
Publication
Local deliverable only.
No Drive upload, source replacement or recurring synchronization was requested or performed.
Maintenance
Update owning sources first, regenerate, then verify coverage and final bytes.
Do not manually edit the archived reading copies and call them newly verified. Capture any new source/version explicitly.
Verification
See Alex_Master_Verification.json for measured acceptance.
File counts, original hashes, source-cell checks, exact text reconstruction and internal links are independently checkable.
SDK addition scope
October 9 report + all 13 cited source files + complete 1.5.1 release folder + extracted package + AI Money workbook.
162 additional records; release receipt is shared with its cited-source entry, without dropping its content.
Source package integrity
136 packaged source files plus PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json are included.
Archive, wheel and external manifest match release SHA256SUMS; source members match the embedded release manifest.
Earlier master preserved
The original 842 source records are retained byte-for-byte from the pre-update archive.
Previous XLSX, archive, verification and build manifest are backed up locally. Earlier dates/status claims are retained as history.
Scope still bounded
This adds the report and its explicit supporting sources; it does not recursively ingest every linked course download or host-specific configuration.
The report itself retains missing/private/remote and adoption gaps. No new installation, SDK execution or cloud publication.
1Password map added
Fresh approved LIST_VAULTS and LIST_ITEMS calls; names/IDs/categories only.
One accessible Connectors vault;51 returned items;35 unique IDs link to37 historical catalog rows;16 lack a saved match;one older ID not returned.
1Password source preservation
Five new source records: sanitized vault list, sanitized item list, map data, complete saved catalog tab snapshot and route card.
Original1004 source records preserved byte-for-byte from pre-update archive. No GET_ITEM, secret field read, write or scope change.
1Password distinction
Fresh item presence is separate from saved purpose, consumers and rotation advice.

All36 catalog entries and2 historical save receipts retained with their original column meanings. Title-based groups are explicitly inferred. Other vaults, permissions, contents and live credential use are unverified.
Long original cells
Original source cells can exceed a comfortable row height. Their full value is retained; use the formula bar or the original workbook in the ZIP for extended text.
